Device monitoring

Device monitoring: see how every device is doing, in one place.

See how all your devices are doing in one place, with alerts when something needs attention. Clear overviews can be set up for your team, your service staff or your own customers.

Send an inquiry

Once devices are with customers, problems usually reach you as a complaint. Monitoring turns that around: devices report their status, and you get an alert when something looks wrong — a fault, an unusual reading, a device that has stopped reporting.

Combined with remote updates, a problem found through monitoring can often be fixed without anyone visiting the device.

What you get

  • All devices in one view
  • Alerts before customers notice
  • Overviews for your team or customers
  • Run and maintained by us

When it helps

  • You learn about faults from customer complaints.
  • Service visits are expensive and often unnecessary.
  • Your customers want to see the status of their devices.

How it works

From the first call to the result.

  1. What to watch

    We agree which data and alerts matter for your product.

  2. Device side

    Status reporting is added to the device's software.

  3. Overviews and alerts

    Views and alerts are set up for your team, service staff or customers.

  4. Operation

    We run and maintain the system.

FAQ

Common questions

Does this work with devices you did not design?

Usually, if the device can send data. It may need a change to its software, which we can make.

Who can see the data?

Only the people you give access to — your team, service staff or your customers, each with their own view.

Do we need our own servers?

No. We run and maintain the monitoring system for you.

Tell us about your project.

Describe the problem or product and where you are now — a rough description is fine. We reply within two working days, and the first call is free.
